'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**During a visit to [[Kyiv]], [[Government of Canada|Canadian]] [[Minister of National Defence (Canada)|National Defence Minister]] [[Anita Anand]] announces that [[Canada]] [[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|will send]] 200 [[Roshel Senator]] [[armoured personnel carrier]]s to [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/canada-ukaine-armoured-personnel-carriers-donation-1.6717597 (CBC News)]
*Spillover of the [[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**Ten [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] militants are killed during a raid by security forces in the village of [[Galmagala]], [[Garissa County]], [[Kenya]], after the group killed five civilians in the region last week. [[Rocket]]-propelled [[grenade]]s and [[improvised explosive device]]s are recovered. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/1/20/kenyan-security-forces-kill-10-suspected-al-shabab-fighters (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Ituri conflict]]
**The [[United Nations]] reports the discovery of [[mass grave]]s in [[Ituri Province]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], containing the bodies of 49 civilians. [[CODECO]] militants are suspected of being behind the killings. [https://apnews.com/article/politics-democratic-republic-of-the-congo-united-nations-1d8ddf4706253b6a221df578062ae9a7 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2023 inflation surge]]
**[[2021–present United Kingdom cost of living crisis]]
***Despite a slight decrease in overall [[inflation]] at the end of last year, food prices in the [[United Kingdom]] increased by 16.9% in the twelve months to December, the highest rate since September 1977, according to the [[Office for National Statistics]]. [https://www.standard.co.uk/news/uk/uk-inflation-december-latest-consumer-price-index-fuel-prices-food-cost-of-living-b1053794.html (''Evening Standard'')]
**[[Microsoft]] announces that it will cut 10,000 jobs, around 5% of its global workforce, amid a slowdown in [[consumer spending]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-64317078 (BBC News)] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Brovary helicopter crash]]
**Fourteen people are killed and 25 others are injured in a [[helicopter crash]] in [[Brovary]], [[Kyiv Oblast]], [[Ukraine]]. [[Ministry of Internal Affairs (Ukraine)|Interior minister]] [[Denys Monastyrsky]], [[Ministry of Internal Affairs (Ukraine)|deputy minister of internal affairs]] [[Yevhen Yenin]], and state secretary of internal affairs [[Yurii Lubkovych]] are among those killed. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/1/18/ukraine-helicopter-crash-what-we-know-so-far (Al Jazeera)]
*[[List of earthquakes in 2023]]
**At least 150 people are injured by a magnitude 5.8 [[list of earthquakes in Iran|earthquake]] in [[Khoy]], [[Khoy County]], [[West Azerbaijan]], [[Iran]]. [https://www.mehrnews.com/news/5686019/%DB%B5%DB%B0%DB%B0%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AD%D8%AF-%D9%85%D8%B3%DA%A9%D9%88%D9%86%DB%8C-%D8%AE%D9%88%DB%8C-%D8%AE%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%AA-%D8%AF%DB%8C%D8%AF-%DB%B1%DB%B5%DB%B0-%D9%86%D9%81%D8%B1-%D9%85%D8%B5%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%85-%D8%B4%D8%AF%D9%86%D8%AF (MehrNews)]
*At least 70 people and 70,000 cattle are killed due to freezing temperatures across [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/1/18/dozens-of-people-killed-as-cold-wave-sweeps-afghanistan (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Stop Cop City]]
**A protester is killed and a [[Georgia State Patrol]] trooper is injured after they exchange fire during a clearing operation against demonstrators attempting to prevent the construction of a [[police training]] facility at a forest in [[Atlanta]], [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]], [[United States]]. [https://www.ajc.com/neighborhoods/dekalb/breaking-trooper-shot-near-atlanta-training-center-site/SOQLFIHNP5GW3GQV4EZBXIK5F4/ (''Atlanta Journal-Constitution'')]
*The [[Court of Tax Appeals]] of the [[Philippines]] [[acquit]]s journalist [[Maria Ressa]] and her [[online news]] website [[Rappler]] of charges of [[tax evasion]] filed against them by the [[Government of the Philippines|government]] in 2018. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20230118-philippine-nobel-laureate-maria-ressa-acquitted-of-tax-evasion (AFP via RFI)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Antiguan general election]]
**Citizens in [[Antigua and Barbuda]] head to [[polling place|the polls]] to elect members of the [[House of Representatives (Antigua and Barbuda)|House of Representatives]]. [https://jamaica-gleaner.com/article/world-news/20230118/general-election-antigua-and-barbuda (''Jamaica Gleaner'')]
*[[8 January Brasília attacks| 2023 Brazilian Congress attack]]
**[[President of Brazil|President]] [[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva]] dismisses 13 more [[military personnel]] from the presidential cabinet whom he blames for the January 8 attack in [[Brasília]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/lula-dismisses-more-military-personnel-security-detail-after-brazil-riots-2023-01-18/ (Reuters)]
